full_prompt_en: A square expressive oil painting frames a young woman closely from the shoulders upward against a saturated orange background. She has loosely gathered brown hair with a few strands escaping across the forehead. Both hands lift to her face: fingers touch her temples and cheeks, while the lower palms support her jaw. Her gaze drifts slightly upward and to the right, and her closed pink lips and relaxed brows make the expression reflective rather than dramatic. A teal-green patterned garment occupies the lower corners, its loose floral or abstract marks echoing small orange patches from the backdrop. A faint hand-drawn circular line arcs behind the head, barely visible through the broad orange paint. The face and hands are formed from short, angular strokes of ochre, peach, coral, gray-green, and muted cream. Darker umber edges appear around the hair, eyelids, nose, and finger gaps, but the paint remains visibly broken rather than smoothly blended. Warm light seems to come from the front-left, catching the forehead, cheekbones, fingertips, and lower lip; soft shadows deepen around the eyes and beneath the chin. The background is broad and comparatively flat, with subtle scraping and canvas grain instead of scenic detail. The tight composition leaves little empty margin and lets the hands create two curved brackets around the central face. The whole image feels intimate and quietly unsettled, its physical pose made vivid by brisk painterly color and the push-pull of orange and cool teal.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅方形表现性油画在饱和橙色背景前近距离框住一位年轻女子的肩以上部分。她把棕发松松拢起，几缕发丝落过额头。双手抬到脸旁：手指接触太阳穴和面颊，下方手掌托住下颌。目光略向右上飘去，闭合的粉色嘴唇与放松的眉让神情偏沉思而非戏剧化。蓝绿色花纹衣服占据下方两角，松散的花形或抽象笔痕呼应背景少量橙斑。一条淡淡手绘圆线在头后拱起，几乎隐在宽阔橙色颜料里。脸与手由赭黄、桃色、珊瑚、灰绿和柔暗奶油色的短而有棱角的笔触组成。头发、眼睑、鼻翼与指缝周围有更深赭棕边，但颜料保持可见的断笔，而非平滑融合。暖光像从左前方来，捉住额头、颧骨、指尖和下唇；柔影在眼周与下巴下加深。背景宽阔且相对平坦，只有细微刮擦和画布颗粒，没有风景细节。紧凑构图几乎不留外边，双手在中央脸庞两侧形成弯曲括号。整幅画像贴近而微微不安的沉思片刻，迅疾绘画色彩及橙与冷蓝绿的推拉让姿态鲜活。
style_prompt_en: Expressive oil painting builds volume from short angular strokes, visible color breaks, and selective dark contours rather than smooth blending. A broad saturated orange field acts as a flat warm pressure behind a compact cluster of ochre, peach, coral, cream, and muted gray-green forms. Cool teal patches near the lower edge counter the warmth and carry loose patterned marks. Fine scraping, faint construction arcs, and canvas grain remain visible within otherwise simple background color. Front-side light catches raised planes in warm pale strokes; softer umber shadows gather in recesses. Close cropping and paired curved shapes make the central area intimate and tense, while the open color field prevents the active brushwork from becoming visually noisy.
style_prompt_zh: 表现性油画靠短而有棱角的笔触、可见色块断裂和选择性深轮廓塑造体积，而非平滑融合。宽阔饱和橙色场像温暖压力，衬托紧凑的赭黄、桃色、珊瑚、奶油和柔暗灰绿形体簇。靠下缘的冷蓝绿斑块抵消暖色，并承载松散图案笔痕。细微刮擦、淡淡构造弧线和画布颗粒在其他简单的背景色中仍可见。前侧光以淡暖笔触捉住凸面，柔赭影聚在凹处。贴近裁切与成对弯曲形使中央区域亲密而紧张，开放色场又避免活跃笔触变成视觉噪声。
theme_en: A contemplative young woman resting her face in both hands against orange
theme_zh: 一位沉思的年轻女子双手托脸，身后是橙色背景
name: Xenia Hausner
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
